statement_en: Let $A\subset \{1,\ldots,N\}$ be a Sidon set with $\lvert A\rvert\sim N^{1/2}$. Must $A+A$ be well-distributed over all small moduli? In particular, must about half the elements of $A+A$ be even and half odd?
statement_lean:
open Function Set
open scoped Pointwise
variable {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α]
def IsSidon (A : Set α) : Prop := ∀ᵉ (i₁ ∈ A) (j₁ ∈ A) (i₂ ∈ A) (j₂ ∈ A),
  i₁ + i₂ = j₁ + j₂ → (i₁ = j₁ ∧ i₂ = j₂) ∨ (i₁ = j₂ ∧ i₂ = j₁)

open Filter Finset
open scoped Pointwise

theorem erdos_91594 :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (N : ℕ → ℕ) (A : ℕ → Finset ℕ),
      Tendsto (fun k => (N k : ℝ)) atTop atTop →
      (∀ k, ∀ x ∈ A k, x ≤ N k) →
      (∀ k, IsSidon (A k : Set ℕ)) →
      Tendsto (fun k => ((A k).card : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (N k)) atTop (nhds 1) →
      ∀ i < m, Tendsto
        (fun k => (((A k + A k).filter (fun s => s % m = i)).card : ℝ) / ((A k + A k).card : ℝ))
        atTop (nhds (1 / m)) := by
  sorry
